ld:
Thrust Shot is an online multiplayer third-person shooter for up to 6 players featuring jetpacks.
Jump into quick deathmatch battles against players from around the world.
Thrust Shot focuses on fast-paced gameplay, use your thrusters to jump over buildings and take down your enemies with a variety of weapons.
Level up your online character and unlock new weapons to help you on your battles.
The game also features single player mode against enemy bots.

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
